info.title: data.police.uk
info.description: The official UK street-level crime API — Home Office open data, no key, no account. Coverage is England, Wales and Northern Ireland (Scotland's forces publish separately, so Scottish coordinates return few or no records — say so rather than reporting 'no crime'). Data is published MONTHLY with a lag of one to two months; `crimeLastUpdated` names the latest month.

get.summary: All police-recorded street-level crimes within one mile of a coordinate pair, for one month
get.description: Returns a JSON ARRAY of incidents within a 1-mile radius. Each has `category` (slug like burglary, violent-crime, vehicle-crime, anti-social-behaviour), `month` (YYYY-MM), `location.street.name` (an anonymised street-level locality, e.g. 'On or near Shopping Area'), `location.latitude`/`longitude` (anonymised snap-points, not exact addresses), and `outcome_status` (`null` while under investigation). City centres can return thousands of rows for one month.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the search centre, decimal degrees.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Month as YYYY-MM. Omit for the latest published month.

200.description: Array of incidents; empty for quiet areas, Scotland, or months not yet published.

get.summary: The police force and neighbourhood policing team covering a coordinate pair
get.description: Returns `{force, neighbourhood}` — both IDs. Pass them to `neighbourhoodDetails` for the human-readable name. 404 outside England/Wales/NI.

get.summary: A neighbourhood policing team's name and description

200.description: Neighbourhood details; `name` is the human-readable team name.
